desc: Implement the lazy segment tree with range-add, threshold search, and point-query operations.
Process each contest by finding \(a=\min\{x:F(x)\ge L\}\) and \(b=\min\{x:F(x)>R\}\), then add 1 on \([a,b-1]\) when nonempty.
Verify that monotonicity is preserved and that searching by node maxima correctly finds contiguous affected domains, including equal values and absent upper boundaries.
Use domain size \(M=500000\), since only queried initial ratings need to be represented; final ratings may exceed \(M\) through accumulated lazy additions.
Add fast input parsing and point-query output, then check all provided samples and edge cases.
